# Boolean {#sec-boolean}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}
Eny na tsia!

Boolean is the first building block of any object.
For many this is a binary, a sequence of 0 and 1.
But the boolean has a deeper meaning.
We can then encode it either as 0, 1, TRUE or FALSE, or T and F.
This is used when you have two outcomes: dead or alive, present or absent etc... it can take many forms

The concern is that in that many forms, what type of variable is it? In statistics, is it a qualitative, discrete, continuous? Well it is supposed to be qualitative and it is about notation.
But R you can add them and only add them! Why they did that, it is convenient.
